_comment: Field-mapping manifest for the IMSR dated 2026-06-12. Documents, per normalized target field, where it comes from in the report, its unit/type, whether it is required, and a verbatim example snippet from the source text. This manifest is DOCUMENTATION — the extractor implements equivalent logic but does not read this file.

fields.imsr_source: Page 1 header line
Page 1 header line 'National Preparedness Level'
Page 1, Active Incident Resource Summary, 'Total' row, 'Crews' column
fields.note: Order in Total row: Incidents, Cumulative Acres, Crews, Engines, Helicopters, Total Personnel, Change in Personnel.

fields.imsr_source: Page 1, Active Incident Resource Summary, 'Total' row, 'Engines' column
Page 1, Active Incident Resource Summary, 'Total' row, 'Helicopters' column
Page 1, Active Incident Resource Summary, 'Total' row, 'Total Personnel' column
NOT PRESENT in this report
fields.note: The national IMSR does not break out an 'overhead' total. Left absent; do not fabricate.

fields.imsr_source: Per-area section header (pages 2-3), e.g. 'Rocky Mountain Area (PL 2)'; area name mapped to the GACC abbreviation used in the page-1 summary (AICC/NWCC/ONCC/OSCC/NRCC/GBCC/SWCC/RMCC/EACC/SACC).
fields.note: ONLY present for areas that have a large-incident section. NWCC, OSCC, NRCC, EACC have no section in this report, so their per-GACC PL is NOT derivable here.

fields.imsr_source: Per-area section header parenthetical '(PL n)'
Per-area incident table, 'Incident Name' column
fields.note: Name may be multi-word or numeric (e.g. '340'). Boundary with Unit is anchored on the Unit code pattern [A-Z]{2}-[A-Z]{3}.

fields.imsr_source: DERIVED: '<Unit>/<Incident Name>' (the IMSR has no stable incident id)
fields.note: Convention chosen so fixture and extractor key consistently. NOT an official id.

fields.imsr_source: DERIVED from the first two letters of the Unit code
The enclosing per-area section header (current area while parsing rows)
fields.example_raw: Rocky Mountain Area (PL 2)  ... South Fork NE-NBF ...

Incident table, 'Crw' column (4 tokens after the 'Ctn' token)
fields.note: NOTE: Putah detail 'Crw' = 19, but the page-1 ONCC summary 'Crews' = 22. Intra-document disagreement; the incident bucket uses the detail value.
